why: acceptance 3 offers the ring extension or a nav-specific traversal; one sequence over one fn is the smallest change that reaches every section, and the dynamic row count lives in nav_rows — the one enumeration the render and the key map share
evidence: crates/riff-gui-nsh/src/shell/mod.rs Slot/step; crates/riff-gui-nsh/src/shell/layout.rs keyboard; tests in shell::mod
